import { Decoder } from './ltx/decoder.ts';
import { ChecksumFlag, lockPgno } from './ltx/constants.ts';
import { checksumPageWithHasher } from './ltx/checksum.ts';
import { Crc64, CRC_PROFILE } from './ltx/crc64.ts';
import { FileReader, FileSink } from './file-io.ts';
import { restoreControl } from './restore-native.ts';
declare function __sbEnv(name: string): string;

// Only the immutable, single-TXID files emitted by the native capture writer are accepted.
// A copied generation or a stopped writer is required. Never restore over an existing DB.
export function restoreGeneration(source: string, output: string, target: string): string {
  let temporary = '';
  let sink: FileSink | null = null;
  try {
    const available = BigInt(restoreControl('scan', source, ''));
    const last = target ? BigInt(target) : available;
    if (last < 1n || last > available) throw new Error('requested TXID is outside this generation');
    temporary = restoreControl('temp', output, '');
    sink = new FileSink(temporary);
    let checksum = ChecksumFlag, pageSize = 0, pages = 0;
    const hash = new Crc64();
    for (let txid = 1n; txid <= last; txid++) {
      const hex = txid.toString(16).padStart(16, '0');
      const input = new FileReader(source + '/' + hex + '-' + hex + '.ltx');
      try {
        const decoder = new Decoder(new Uint8Array(0));
        decoder.setReader(input); decoder.setRetainPageIndex(false); decoder.decodeHeader();
        const h = decoder.Header();
        if (h.flags !== 0 || h.minTXID !== txid || h.maxTXID !== txid ||
            h.preApplyChecksum !== (txid === 1n ? 0n : checksum) ||
            (pageSize !== 0 && h.pageSize !== pageSize)) throw new Error('LTX chain continuity failed');
        pageSize = h.pageSize;
        const lock = lockPgno(pageSize), data = new Uint8Array(pageSize), old = new Uint8Array(pageSize);
        for (let pgno = h.commit + 1; pgno <= pages; pgno++) {
          if (pgno === lock) continue;
          sink.readAt(old, (pgno - 1) * pageSize);
          checksum = ChecksumFlag | (checksum ^ checksumPageWithHasher(hash, pgno, old));
        }
        let previous = 0, growth = pages + 1;
        for (;;) {
          const ph = decoder.decodePage(data);
          if (!ph) break;
          const pgno = ph.pgno;
          if (pgno <= previous || pgno === lock || ph.flags !== 1) throw new Error('invalid LTX page order or flags');
          previous = pgno;
          if (pgno <= pages) {
            sink.readAt(old, (pgno - 1) * pageSize);
            checksum = ChecksumFlag | (checksum ^ checksumPageWithHasher(hash, pgno, old));
          } else {
            if (growth === lock) growth++;
            if (pgno !== growth) throw new Error('missing newly allocated page');
            growth++;
          }
          checksum = ChecksumFlag | (checksum ^ checksumPageWithHasher(hash, pgno, data));
          sink.writeAt(data, (pgno - 1) * pageSize);
        }
        if (growth === lock) growth++;
        if (h.commit > pages && growth !== h.commit + 1) throw new Error('incomplete database growth');
        decoder.close();
        if (checksum !== decoder.Trailer().postApplyChecksum) throw new Error('database checksum mismatch');
        pages = h.commit; sink.truncate(pages * pageSize);
      } finally { input.close(); }
    }
    // Verify physical output once, independent of incremental checksum accounting.
    let physical = ChecksumFlag;
    const page = new Uint8Array(pageSize);
    for (let pgno = 1; pgno <= pages; pgno++) {
      if (pgno === lockPgno(pageSize)) continue;
      sink.readAt(page, (pgno - 1) * pageSize);
      physical = ChecksumFlag | (physical ^ checksumPageWithHasher(hash, pgno, page));
    }
    if (physical !== checksum) throw new Error('physical database checksum mismatch');
    sink.sync(); sink.close(); sink = null;
    restoreControl('integrity', temporary, '');
    restoreControl('publish', temporary, output);
    temporary = '';
    const result = { txid: last.toString(), checksum: checksum.toString(16), bytes: pages * pageSize };
    if (CRC_PROFILE[0]) {
      result.crcMs = CRC_PROFILE[1];
      result.crcBytes = CRC_PROFILE[2];
    }
    return JSON.stringify(result);
  } finally {
    if (sink) sink.close();
    try { if (temporary) restoreControl('unlink', temporary, ''); }
    finally { restoreControl('release', '', ''); }
  }
}

export function restoreStartup(): void {
  try {
    CRC_PROFILE[3] = 1;
    const result = restoreGeneration(__sbEnv('SB_LTX_RESTORE_GENERATION'), __sbEnv('SB_LTX_RESTORE_OUTPUT'), __sbEnv('SB_LTX_RESTORE_TXID'));
    restoreControl('quit', '0', result);
  } catch (error) { restoreControl('quit', '1', String(error)); }
}
